name: Jausenstation Schrandlhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jausenstation Schrandlhof in Westendorf**

Discover a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal**, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets hearty mountain cuisine. At **Jausenstation Schrandlhof**, you’ll find the perfect spot to refuel after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, freshly whipped with powdered sugar, or savor a warm bowl of **Käsespätzle**—a true comfort food. Our menu also features locally sourced meats, fresh bread, and homemade pastries, all crafted with love by our team.

Whether you're a guest at one of the nearby hotels or just passing through, stop by for a relaxing break. Enjoy the rustic charm of our wooden interiors, the crackling fireplace, and the breathtaking views of the **Karwendel** mountains.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Westendorf** is the ideal base for adventure and relaxation. Visit us and experience the warmth of Tyrolean guest culture—**Grüß Gott!**
